      l[k]? = some e →
        e.isConfChange →

                        isCluster γ N ∗

                              nodeConfig n γ N v ∗ deliveredLogLb n γ N l ∗ skippedIn γ l v.applied k -∗
                    (▷
                        ∀ csp cs,

                                nodeConfig n γ N { applied := k + 1, membership := m' } ∗ ⌜confStateIs cs m'⌝ ∨

                      WP

  -- `Perennial.EtcdGrove.RestartNode.spec`, unfolded:
  ∀ (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (vs : List w64) (c : Loc) (cv : Config) (lok si : GoInterfaceOk) (hs : HardStateM)
    (csm : ConfStateM) (Q : IProp GF),
    ConfigValid cv →
      cv.Logger' = GoInterface.ok lok →
        cv.Storage' = GoInterface.ok si →
          sint.Z cv.MaxInflightMsgs' < 2 ^ 62 →
            cv.DisableProposalForwarding' = false →
              cv.ReadOnlyOption' = W64 0 →
                cv.DisableConfChangeValidation' = false →
                  cv.MaxCommittedSizePerReady' ≠ W64 0 ∨ cv.MaxSizePerMsg' ≠ W64 0 →
                    cv.AsyncStorageWrites' = false →
                      cv.Applied' = W64 0 →
                        HsEmpty hs →
                          csm.Voters' = vs →
                            csm.VotersOutgoing' = [] →
                              csm.Learners' = [] →
                                csm.LearnersNext' = [] →
                                  csm.AutoLeave' = false →
                                    ⊢
                                      ∀ Φ,
                                        isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3 ∗
                                            typedPointsto c cv (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                                              isLogger lok ∗
                                                bootStorage γ cv.ID' (GoInterface.ok si) hs csm Q ∗
                                                  (nodeFounder γ N vs cv.ID' ∨
                                                    nodeJoin γ N cv.ID' ∗
                                                      confAt γ 0 (Membership.simple (listToSet vs)) ∗ ⌜vs.Nodup⌝) -∗
                                          (▷
                                              ∀ nd,
                                                (∃ n,
                                                    ⌜nd = interface.mkOk node.ty.PointerType (intoVal n)⌝ ∗
                                                      isNode n γ N cv.ID' ∗
                                                        nodeDriver n γ N (NodeDriverState.init (GoInterface.ok si)) ∗
                                                          nodeConfig n γ N
                                                              { applied := 0,
                                                                membership := Membership.simple (listToSet vs) } ∗
                                                            nodeRunning n γ N 1 ∗ Q) -∗
                                                  Φ (intoVal nd)) -∗
                                            WP ((intoVal (functions RestartNode [])) (intoVal c)) {{ Φ }}

theorem RaftLink.MemoryStorage.wp_Entries [package_sem : Assumptions] : MemoryStorage.Entries.spec
  -- `Perennial.EtcdGrove.MemoryStorage.Entries.spec`, unfolded:
  ∀ (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (k : Nat) (dq1 dq2 : DFrac) (a b : List EntryM) (lo hi maxSize : w64)
    (ec : GoInterface),
    ⊢
      ∀ Φ,
        isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3 ∗
            memStorLock ms γs ∗
              memLog γs k dq1 a ∗

                  ⌜k ≤ uint.nat lo ∧ uint.nat lo < uint.nat hi ∧ uint.nat hi ≤ k + a.length + b.length⌝ ∗
                    typedPointsto (globalAddr ErrCompacted) ec DFrac.discard -∗
          (▷
              ∀ s es err,
                memLog γs k dq1 a ∗
                    memLog γs (k + a.length) dq2 b ∗
                      (⌜err = ec⌝ ∗ memCompacted γs (uint.nat lo) ∨
                        ⌜err = GoInterface.nil⌝ ∗
                          entsRO s es ∗
                            ⌜es ≠ [] ∧
                                s.cap = s.len ∧
                                  es <+: List.take (uint.nat hi - uint.nat lo) (List.drop (uint.nat lo - k) (a ++ b))⌝) -∗
                  Φ (intoVal s, intoVal err)) -∗
            WP
              ((((intoVal
                      (methods MemoryStorage.ty.PointerType go!"Entries"
                        (intoVal ms)))
                    (intoVal lo))
                  (intoVal hi))
                (intoVal maxSize))
              {{ Φ }}

theorem RaftLink.node.wp_Advance [package_sem : Assumptions] : node.Advance.spec
  -- `Perennial.EtcdGrove.node.Advance.spec`, unfolded:
  ∀ (n : Loc) (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (id : w64) (st : NodeDriverState) (es : List EntryM) (L : Option SnapLoan)
    (v : ConfigView),
    st.handling = some (es, L) →
      (∀ (l : SnapLoan), L = some l → l.dlv.length = uint.nat l.snap.Metadata'.Index') →
        ⊢
          ∀ Φ,
            (isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3 ∗
                isCluster γ N ∗
                  isNode n γ N id ∗
                    nodeDriver n γ N st ∗
                      advReceipt st.storage st.delivered.length es L ∗
                        nodeConfig n γ N v ∗
                          match L with
                          | none => skippedIn γ st.delivered v.applied st.delivered.length
                          | some l => snapshotCert γ N (snapTrip l.snap l.snap.Metadata'.ConfState'.lists)) -∗
              ▷
                  ((nodeDriver n γ N
                          { storage := st.storage, delivered := st.delivered, hardState := st.hardState,
                            handling := none } ∗
                        nodeAppliedLb γ id st.delivered.length ∗
                          match L with
                          | none => nodeConfig n γ N v
                          | some l =>
                            ∃ m,
                              nodeConfig n γ N { applied := uint.nat l.snap.Metadata'.Index', membership := m } ∗
                                confAt γ (uint.nat l.snap.Metadata'.Index') m ∗
                                  ⌜confStateIs l.snap.Metadata'.ConfState' m⌝) ∨
                      nodeStopped n γ N ∗
                        nodeDriver n γ N
                          { storage := st.storage, delivered := st.delivered, hardState := st.hardState,
                            handling := none } -∗
                    Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
                WP
                  ((intoVal (methods node.ty.PointerType go!"Advance" (intoVal n)))
                    (intoVal ()))
                  {{ Φ }}

theorem RaftLink.MemoryStorage.wp_ApplySnapshot [package_sem : Assumptions] :
    MemoryStorage.ApplySnapshot.spec
  -- `Perennial.EtcdGrove.MemoryStorage.ApplySnapshot.spec`, unfolded:
  ∀ (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (J : MemJust GF) (j : Nat) (old : List EntryM) (sp : Loc) (dq : DFrac)
    (sv sv0 : SnapshotM) (eood : GoInterface),
    j ≤ uint.nat sv.Metadata'.Index' →
      uint.nat sv.Metadata'.Index' < 2 ^ 61 →
        ⊢
          ∀ Φ,
            isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3 ∗
                memStorInvP ms γs J ∗
                  memLog γs j (DFrac.own 1) old ∗
                    memEnd γs (j + old.length) ∗
                      J.B (uint.nat sv.Metadata'.Index') ∗
                        J.SV sv ∗
                          J.DL (uint.nat sv.Metadata'.Index') ∗
                            snapArg sp dq sv ∗
                              memSnapExact γs sv0 ∗ typedPointsto (globalAddr ErrSnapOutOfDate) eood DFrac.discard -∗
              ▷
                  (ownSnapM sp dq sv ∗
                      memCompacted γs (uint.nat sv.Metadata'.Index') ∗
                        memLog γs (uint.nat sv.Metadata'.Index') DFrac.discard [memDummy sv] ∗
                          memEnd γs (uint.nat sv.Metadata'.Index' + 1) ∗ memSnapExact γs sv -∗
                    Φ (intoVal GoInterface.nil)) -∗
                WP
                  ((intoVal
                      (methods MemoryStorage.ty.PointerType
                        go!"ApplySnapshot"
                        (intoVal ms)))
                    (intoVal sp))
                  {{ Φ }}

theorem RaftLink.MemoryStorage.wp_Append [package_sem : Assumptions] : MemoryStorage.Append.spec
  -- `Perennial.EtcdGrove.MemoryStorage.Append.spec`, unfolded:
  ∀ (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (k : Nat) (old es : List EntryM) (s : GoSlice) (dq : DFrac),
    (∀ (j : Nat) (e : EntryM), es[j]? = some e → uint.nat e.Index' = k + j) →
      k + es.length ≤ 2 ^ 61 →
        ⊢
          ∀ Φ,
            isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3 ∗
                memStorLock ms γs ∗
                  (if es = [] then emp else memLog γs k (DFrac.own 1) old ∗ memEnd γs (k + old.length)) ∗
                    entsPts s dq es -∗
              ▷
                  ((entsPts s dq es ∗
                      if es = [] then emp else memLog γs k (DFrac.own 1) es ∗ memEnd γs (k + es.length)) -∗
                    Φ (intoVal GoInterface.nil)) -∗
                WP
                  ((intoVal (methods MemoryStorage.ty.PointerType go!"Append" (intoVal ms)))
                    (intoVal s))
                  {{ Φ }}

                        ⌜MarshalsConfChange (some o) bs⌝ ∗
                          ownCommittedOps γ
                            (ops ++ opsOf [{ term := t, type := confChangeEntryType (some o), data := bs }]),
                        COMM True }> -∗
          (▷ ∀ err, ownConfChangeI c dq (some o) ∗ nodeErrS n γ N cd err -∗ Φ (intoVal err)) -∗

  -- `Perennial.EtcdGrove.node.Propose.spec`, unfolded:

                        ownCommittedOps γ (ops ++ [{ term := t, type := W32 0, data := data }]), COMM True }> -∗
